title: Princeton PEAR lab random event generator 'rebound effect'
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Princeton PEAR lab random event generator 'rebound effect', about unspecified (PEAR lab era) at Princeton, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: A close friend and mentor of mine used to specialize in this experiment at Princeton, their Paris psychology lab or the the pair lab where they studied all sorts of anomalous, you know, stuff. And he would call this the rebound effect.
